positive_snippets: We hosted a party at Villa Anantham today and it was an absolutely fantastic experience! The property is stunning and provided the perfect farm location for our celebration. The ambiance is elegant yet comfortable, and our guests couldn't stop praising the vibe of the place.

We came here as an office team and it was an amazing experience. Staff held our space so mindfully and took care of all the needs. We were welcomed with beautiful flowers and a cake. We felt pampered and didn't want to leave the place. Thank you anantam team for accommodating us

The overall experience was very good. The place is very nicely maintained. The room's are very spacious with a proper walk-in dressing room and well equipped bathroom. The staff is very courteous friendly and approachable.
An highly recommended place to organize public or private events for small and medium gathering

Manjeet was very good and polite. A special thanks to him for taking care of us very nicely and looking into all our request and requirements
